summary: A Palestinian family's home burned after the family reported masked settlers attacked it; police initially attributed the fire to an electrical short circuit, while later remand reporting said police had not produced a final fire-department report and arson had not been ruled out.
discovery_sources: Times of Israel 2026-08-20 and 2026-08-26; police forensic statement quoted by ToI; WAFA 2026-08-20
resolution_notes: Freshness recheck found no final forensic/fire-service resolution. Exact fire/aftermath footage verifies the fire but not cause or perpetrator. Initial official police attribution remains electrical failure, while later remand reporting says the final fire report was not produced and arson had not been ruled out. Preserve the contradiction and do not canonically label this settler arson or treat the homeowner's later legal trouble as proof the initial allegation was false.
media_status: Exact same-event fire video exists, but it does not establish cause or actor. No generic imagery.
